summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs with int64 (ndim, 2) coordinates computed by removing padding offsets; set_rnd skips dunder attributes; docstring updated). monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter wrapping iter_patch with copy-back disabled and channel-prepended patch_size/start_pos; GridPatchDataset reworked to take dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; NotImplementedError when dataset lacks len(); transform applied via apply_transform map_items=False; math import replaced by numpy ceil; PatchIter added to __all__; PatchDataset docstring uses float). monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter. docs/source/data.rst gained a PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset. tests/test_grid_dataset.py added with TestGridPatchDataset (test_shape, test_loading_array). Nothing was run: tests, scripts, and installs were not executed per instructions, so pytest on tests/test_grid_dataset.py is still needed to verify. Pre-existing lines 228-230 in utils.py exceed 120 characters in an untouched docstring and were left alone. No commits were made.
